title: Cart total omits the shipping charge after adding a keyboard
description: The visible Shipping charge is not included in the displayed Total for a cart below the free-shipping threshold.

steps: Compare the displayed Shipping and Total values
report.expected: For a .00 Keyboard plus .00 shipping, Total should be .00.
report.actual: The page displays .00 shipping but Total remains .00.
report.context: Fresh browser storage and an initially empty cart.

preconditions: User has a shopping cart with items added
Cart total is below the free‑shipping threshold
Shipping charge is displayed separately on the cart page
steps: 1. Add items to the cart such that the subtotal is below the free‑shipping threshold.
2. Navigate to the cart or checkout page.
3. Verify that the shipping charge is shown as a separate line item.
5. Confirm that the shipping charge is not added to the total.
reproduction.expected: The total displayed should include the shipping charge, resulting in a higher total amount.
reproduction.actual: The total displayed excludes the shipping charge, showing only the item subtotal.
